name: amos22
title: AMOS 22: abdominal multi-organ segmentation, 600 CT and MRI with 15 organ labels
description: The AMOS benchmark (Ji et al., NeurIPS 2022): 500 CT and 100 MRI scans with 15 abdominal organs annotated; 240 training, 120 validation and 240 test images. Read case by case out of the 24 GB zip64 archive on Zenodo (HTTP Range: the 1 207-entry central directory costs 145 KB, one case its own size). Case ids below 500 are CT, 500 and above are MRI. ds.filter(split='Tr') or 'Va' keeps the labelled cases.

license.note: CC-BY-SA 4.0 as stated in the archive's dataset.json (checked 2026-10-13); the Zenodo record page lists its own licence field, TO CONFIRM that both agree before redistribution.

citation: Ji Y., Bai H., Ge C., et al. AMOS: A Large-Scale Abdominal Multi-Organ Benchmark for Versatile Medical Image Segmentation. NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks.

image.description: Abdominal CT (ids < 500) or MRI (ids >= 500), NIfTI, LPS mm from the header
